basics.description: kista, a trusted repository for DuckDB extensions, on Azure Container Apps: its own managed identity, a channel key in a Key Vault HSM, Blob Storage and a database, in this application's managed resource group. You keep full access to them; the publisher can only read. Prepare the Entra app registrations first: https://hugr-lab.github.io/duckdb-extension-repository/docs/deployment/azure#the-marketplace-application

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Where every resource of kista goes.

basics.name: prefix
basics.label: Name prefix
basics.toolTip: Names every resource: 2 to 10 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

constraints.validationMessage: 2 to 10 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

basics.name: database
basics.label: Database
basics.toolTip: kista's store, reached with Entra authentication only.

options.text: The subscription has not registered every resource provider kista uses. The deployment fails until they are; register them first: az provider register -n Microsoft.App; az provider register -n Microsoft.KeyVault; az provider register -n Microsoft.Storage; az provider register -n Microsoft.OperationalInsights; az provider register -n Microsoft.Network; az provider register -n Microsoft.ManagedIdentity; and Microsoft.DBforPostgreSQL or Microsoft.Sql.
The people who administer kista sign in with Microsoft Entra ID, through an API app registration whose tokens carry an app role, and the console's app registration.

elements.name: tenantId
elements.label: Entra tenant ID
elements.toolTip: The directory (tenant) ID of the Entra ID the administrators sign in at.

elements.name: apiAppId
elements.label: The API app's client ID (the server audience)
elements.toolTip: The application (client) ID of the API app registration: Entra's v2.0 tokens carry it as their audience.

elements.name: adminRole
elements.label: The administrators' app role
elements.toolTip: The value of the API app's role assigned to the administrators; their tokens carry it in roles.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

elements.name: licenseRole
elements.label: The licence managers' app role (optional)
elements.toolTip: The value of the API app's role assigned to the licence managers, who manage every tenant's licences and nothing else; empty, none.

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, or empty.

elements.name: consoleAppId
elements.label: The console app's client ID
elements.toolTip: A single-page application registration; add the redirect URI https://<kista's host>/ui/server/callback after the deployment.

elements.name: name
elements.label: Tenant name
elements.toolTip: The path segment of the tenant's repositories: https://<host>/<tenant>/<channel>/.

elements.name: channel
elements.label: Channel name
elements.toolTip: The tenant's first channel: a DuckDB repository signed with the channel key.

elements.name: duckdb
elements.label: DuckDB version served
elements.toolTip: The DuckDB version the channel serves at first, with its C API and its core extensions; more are added afterwards.

elements.name: tenantId
elements.label: The tenant's Entra tenant ID
elements.toolTip: The directory (tenant) ID of the Entra ID the tenant's administrators sign in at.

elements.name: apiAppId
elements.label: The tenant's API app client ID (its audience)
elements.toolTip: Another app registration than the server's.

validations.message: The tenant's API app must not be the server's.

elements.name: adminRole
elements.label: The tenant administrators' app role

constraints.validationMessage: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens.

elements.toolTip: The value of an app role of the API app, assigned to the administrators.

options.text: The tenant signs in at the server administrators' directory: it gets no console client of its own (a tenant's console never signs in at a server issuer). Its administrators use the API, and server administrators open it in the server console.

elements.name: consoleAppId
elements.label: The tenant console's client ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: The application (client) ID of the console's single-page app registration.

elements.name: cpu
elements.label: vCPUs per replica
elements.toolTip: vCPUs per replica; memory is 2 GiB per vCPU.

elements.name: replicas
elements.label: Replicas
elements.toolTip: kista replicas serving behind Container Apps' ingress.

elements.name: maxBodyMib
elements.label: Largest extension file
elements.toolTip: blob.max_body, the largest extension file; with 1 vCPU, 512 MiB whatever is chosen (a replica's spool fits no more).

elements.name: attestationKey
elements.label: An attestation key for the tenant's signed statements
elements.toolTip: A second Key Vault key that signs the tenant's feed statements (spec 0011).

outputs.bootstrap: [parse(concat('{"versions":[', concat('{"version":"', first(split(steps('tenant').duckdb, '|')), '","kind":"release","c_apis":["', first(skip(split(steps('tenant').duckdb, '|'), 1)), '"],"core_extensions_commit":"', first(skip(split(steps('tenant').duckdb, '|'), 2)), '","core_extensions":["', replace(last(split(steps('tenant').duckdb, '|')), ',', '","'), '"]}'), '],"tenant":{"name":"', steps('tenant').name, '","audiences":["', steps('tenant').apiAppId, '"]},"channel":{"name":"', steps('tenant').channel, '","versions":["', first(split(steps('tenant').duckdb, '|')), '"]},"issuer":{"name":"entra","url":"https://login.microsoftonline.com/', steps('tenant').tenantId, '/v2.0","required_claims":{"tid":"', steps('tenant').tenantId, '"},"roles_claim":"roles"', if(or(equals(steps('tenant').tenantId, steps('admins').tenantId), empty(steps('tenant').consoleAppId)), '', concat(',"console":{"client_id":"', steps('tenant').consoleAppId, '","audience":"', steps('tenant').apiAppId, '","scopes":"openid profile offline_access ', steps('tenant').apiAppId, '/.default"}')), '},"grants":[{"principal":"role:entra|', steps('tenant').adminRole, '","verbs":["admin"]}]}'))]
